steps.title: Initialize App Configuration
steps.description: Establish metadata package name, application name, and define the base structure of Modern Calculator.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Environment
steps.description: Configure the root gradle configuration aligning with Java 17 and AGP 8.3.2 standards without external dependencies.

steps.title: Set Up Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml referencing standard Material themes, proper permissions, correct namespaces, and launcher references.

steps.title: Create Number Button Visuals
steps.description: Design an XML state list selector drawable with appropriate corners and shadows for standard numeric inputs.

steps.title: Create Operator Button Visuals
steps.description: Design dynamic color active/inactive selector backgrounds for operation buttons (+, -, *, /).

steps.title: Create Action/Function Button Visuals
steps.description: Formulate high contrast button backgrounds for system-level actions like clear, backspace, and percentage.

steps.title: Create Equals Button Visuals
steps.description: Assemble specialized theme-accented action drawables highlighting the finish key.

steps.title: Formulate Layout & Typography
steps.description: Develop activity_main.xml layout aligning a premium digital canvas screen and custom formatted rows.

steps.title: Construct Calculator Logic Core
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java integrating math processors, state management, history outputs, floating point handlers, and click bindings.

steps.title: Review Manifest and Theme Mappings
steps.description: Validate target namespaces, theme structures, custom shapes, and verify standard Java 8 syntax controls.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Assemble production-grade application and compile using local workspace runner.
